subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is currently learning battlefield geometry from a Drow wizard in a tunnel, having abandoned his heroic narrative in favor of tactical synergy with Daz, and has accepted the name 'The Ember Grapple' as an accurate descriptor of his role.
source_quote: I am currently learning it from a Drow wizard in a tunnel.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz specializes in area-denial fire spells and has developed a tactical partnership with Zalthir, where his Cloud of Daggers and Darkness spells are precisely coordinated with Zalthir’s grapples, despite initial conflicts over line of sight and targeting.
source_quote: your spell blocked my line of sight, my darkness ate your targeting

subject: The Ember Grapple
fact: The Ember Grapple is an informal tactical unit composed of Zalthir and Daz, defined by Zalthir’s grapple-based control and Daz’s area-of-effect fire magic, operating under the unspoken agreement that one holds while the other burns — a name adopted and humorously endorsed by Thorin and Grygum.
source_quote: Zalthir ties things to the ground for Daz to cook

subject: The Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard is a contrasting tactical identity to The Ember Grapple, characterized by aggressive, flamboyant fire-and-flash assaults — possibly a separate unit or the same party viewed from a different perspective in combat.
source_quote: The Ember Vanguard charges in with fire and flash and the announcement of itself

subject: tactical revelation
fact: Zalthir and Daz achieved a breakthrough in spell synergy by realizing that a grapple fixes a target in space, allowing Daz’s Cloud of Daggers to reliably strike the same square regardless of enemy movement — solving the longstanding problem of spells becoming decoration due to positional drift.
source_quote: a grapple — a proper hold, weight-to-weight, the kind that pins something to a specific square of floor — that solved it.

subject: Cloud of Daggers
fact: Cloud of Daggers is a rotating cage of blades anchored to a fixed point in space, whose effectiveness was historically undermined by enemy movement — until Zalthir’s grapples rendered it a reliable execution tool by eliminating positional variance.
source_quote: a rotating cage of blades, hungry in one fixed point in space

subject: Darkness
fact: Darkness is a spell that obscures vision and disrupts targeting — historically a source of conflict between Zalthir and Daz, but now strategically deployed in coordination with grapples to isolate targets without interfering with Daz’s area effects.

subject: javelins
fact: Javelins have been acquired by Thorin as a tactical tool to hold the line during Zalthir’s grapples and Daz’s fire bursts — selected for their reach and practicality in controlling engagement distance.
source_quote: Thorin mentioned javelins. He had apparently acquired some facility with thrown weapons

subject: the tunnel
fact: The tunnel is a recurring location where Zalthir receives tactical instruction from a Drow wizard, and where the group mentally rehearses their next engagement — a place of quiet study and unspoken preparation.
source_quote: I am currently learning it from a Drow wizard in a tunnel

subject: the Ember Grapple
fact: The name 'The Ember Grapple' has been adopted by the group as a functional descriptor of Zalthir and Daz’s synergy — not one Zalthir originally claimed, but one he accepts as accurate, marking a quiet transformation from lone warrior to tactical anchor.
source_quote: I did not correct it. The name was not wrong.

subject: no long rest
fact: The group operates under the certainty that no long rest will precede their next encounter — they carry all resources forward, with no replenishment expected, and have mentally accounted for every mile traveled and every threat omitted.
source_quote: There would be no long rest before whatever came next.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin has developed proficiency with thrown weapons and coined or popularized the term 'The Ember Grapple,' finding humor in Zalthir’s shift from brute force to tactical restraint — his voice is indistinguishable from Grygum’s in moments of noise.
source_quote: Thorin said something about 'the Ember Grapple.' Someone — possibly Thorin again, possibly Grygum — found this very funny.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum made a sound and is indistinguishable from Thorin in moments of vocalization — likely a participant in the group’s informal naming rituals and a silent witness to Zalthir’s tactical evolution.

subject: tactical redefinition
fact: Zalthir has redefined his role from a warrior who kills with brute force — having killed an ettin and dragged the Pudding King — to a controller who enables others to destroy, accepting that his legacy is now measured in grapples, not glory.
source_quote: I have killed an ettin with my hands. I dragged the Pudding King through his own throne room. And now here I am, discussing the correct knot.
